We're going to need to focus on our firepower to take it down.|audio = TakeoverMasterWave17.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 17 ([[The Takeover Event]], Master)}} }} ==Description== The '''Bulwark''' is a high health enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It has a high amount of health and slightly slow speed, making it quite tough to take down. It also has [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that it cannot be knocked back or stunned, only being slowed down by stuns. ==Appearance== The '''Bulwark''' is a large entity with dark crimson skin. It has a giant mutated right arm with chains wrapped around it and a thin left arm with an arm-band, that has a chain attached to it. It has multiple giant scars on its skin. On its head, it has a single yellow neon eye. Multiple molten rocks stick out of its body. It wears a tattered piece of leather which covers its lower parts. It also has a grey neck guard. It has a death animation, where it falls forward, with its mutated arm completely detaching in the process. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Hunter]], [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]] are recommended to take this enemy down. **The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] can be used to boost these towers. *Due to its [[Stun Immunity]], it will not be stopped by stuns and will instead only be slowed down, making towers like the [[Tesla]] far less effective. **It will also be unable to be knocked back by towers like the [[Brawler]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} BulwarkWalkAnimation.gif|Walk animation (11 December 2024 – Present) BulwarkDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (11 December 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Bulwark.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseBulwark.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} MoltenModeUpdateThumbnail.png|'''Bulwark''' on a game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NewMoltenThumbnailClean.png|'''Bulwark''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|'''Bulwark''' on a promotional video. Operator Tower Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator |'''Bulwark''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Valentines Skins - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Bulwark''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} MoltenReworkYoutubeThumbnail.jpeg|'''Bulwark''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexBulwark.png|'''Bulwark''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Bulwark''' looks like a combination of the [[Living Experiment]] and [[Tank 2]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Bulwark''' added. **{{Bug}} [[Jester]]'s defense dropping does not reduce '''Bulwark's''' defense. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **Health increased from 4,000 to 4,500. *'''12 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3a]] **Now appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]] Master difficulty as part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ***Has 4,500 health in [[Sk8 P4rk]]. **Cash given is now mode dependent. ***Most modes now give {{Money|1,980}} every 33% health. ***Default value is {{Money|2}} every 33% health. *'''22 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3g]] **No longer appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]], as it has been removed. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **First wave appearance changed from 28 to 25. **Health increased from 4,500 to 6,000. **Speed decreased from Average (3) to Slightly Slow (2.25). **Cash given increased from {{Money|1,980}} every 33% health lost to {{Money|3,000}} every 50% health lost in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. **Default cash given increased from {{Money|2}} every 33% health lost to {{Money|3}} every 50% health lost. **[[Defense]] removed. }} ==Notes== {{Molten|[[Molten Mech]]|Wave 23|Bulwark|Wave 25|[[Elite Molten]]|Wave 27}} {{TakeoverMaster|[[Molten Mech]]|Wave 16|Bulwark & [[Tanker]]|Wave 17|[[Elite Molten]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
